messages:
nina: posted a new Figma for progressive-disclosure in the first-run flow. goal: surface advanced settings (quantization, region pinning, telemetry opt-out) behind a "More options" toggle instead of the main banner. link in thread.

sam: 👍 overall I like hiding advanced stuff. two engineering concerns: 1) we need to persist the opt-out choice in the account settings and not just localStorage; 2) toggling should be keyboard-friendly and not collapse content unexpectedly.

eli: accessibility: ensure the "More options" toggle is a button with aria-expanded state and that the expanded panel is a region with aria-labelledby. also when users opt-out of telemetry, announce "Telemetry disabled" in an aria-live polite region.

maria: copy suggestion for the banner: primary = "Create sample project"; under it a subtle line: "Quickstart will create a preconfigured project with sample data." then a clear link: "More options" which opens the panel. inside panel include "Opt out of sample-usage telemetry" with short explainer.

privacy-bot: policy note: per privacy policy, opt-out must be honored immediately and reflected in analytics events (set property telemetry_opt_out=true). also include a link to the full privacy doc.

sam: implementation detail: we'll add a server-side flag on the account profile and send an identify call to analytics when toggled. ENG-5010.

eli: keyboard focus: when panel opens, focus should move to the first input inside. Escape closes panel and returns focus to the More options button. no auto-scrolling.

maria: small microcopy rec: inside panel change "Telemetry" to "Usage telemetry (helps us improve the quickstart)" to be explicit. add a secondary link "Learn what we collect" that opens the privacy doc.

eng-lead: can we add an experiment to see if showing the opt-out inline vs a post-creation toast affects conversion? worried inline might reduce sample creation. suggest flag onboarding_options_inline_vs_post.

nina: good idea. I'll wire two variants in the spec and add expected metric names: sample_created, telemetry_opt_out_rate.

privacy-bot: compliance note: if user opts out we must not send sample event payloads containing code snippets or prompt text. only send high-level success events. annotate event schema.

sam: noted. we'll scrub payloads server-side if telemetry_opt_out=true. also will add a guard in the quickstart lambda.

eli: a11y nit: the opt-out checkbox needs an accessible description explaining what opting out means (aria-describedby -> short id). avoid long paragraphs being read.

maria: copy for checkbox label: "Opt out of sample usage telemetry" with helper text: "We will not collect your sample prompts or code; we only record that you tried the quickstart." will add translation keys.

nina: small UI ask: show a subtle badge on the project card if user opted out (eye-slash icon + label "Telemetry off") so users can see current state. ensure contrast passes.

sam: implementing badge is fine. will keep as non-interactive element but linkable to settings page. ENG-5011.

eng-lead: timeline: prefer this behind a feature flag and beta rollout to 5% accounts until privacy QA passes. also require a quick automated test that toggles opt-out and verifies analytics payloads are suppressed.

privacy-bot: pre-rollout checklist: update privacy page, audit event schemas, log opt-out changes, and run manual verification. attach checklist to PR.

eli: test plan: keyboard nav, screenreader announcement on toggle, contrast check for badge, analytics suppression test, accessibility smoke on mobile.

maria: copy finalization: please drop any wording tweaks by EOD Friday. i'll lock keys and send to i18n on Monday.

nina: thanks all  i'll upload the updated Figma and create tickets ENG-5010/ENG-5011. will ping when PRs are up. :slightly_smiling_face:
